The description clearly states: "it also swings completely out of the way, even when fully loaded with up to 4 bikes" and feature #1 says "4 bike rack swings away with bikes loaded to provide ultimate access to vehicle."

The Yakima Flipside 4 (id: 59498) also has a tilt/swing feature, but it tilts 90 degrees to the left or right. However, the SwingDaddy is more specifically designed for swinging out of the way with bikes loaded.

The answer is the Yakima SwingDaddy (id: 372160).
